title: Maximum nonlinearity of even-dimensional vectorial functions
summary: Determine whether the conjectured value is the maximum nonlinearity of every square vectorial Boolean function in even dimension.

formal_statement.body: For every positive even integer $n$, is $$\max_{F:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2^n}\operatorname{NL}(F)=2^{n-1}-2^{n/2},$$ where $\operatorname{NL}(F)$ is the minimum nonlinearity among the nonzero scalar components of $F$? Prove that no $(n,n)$-function exceeds the known attainable value, or exhibit an $(n,n)$-function with larger nonlinearity.

scope.domain: Nonlinearity of square vectorial Boolean functions in even dimensions
assumptions: Vectorial nonlinearity is measured over all nonzero scalar components
scope.unresolved_remainder: No inspected result proves the maximum $2^{n-1}-2^{n/2}$ for all even-dimensional (n,n)-functions or constructs a function exceeding it.

progress.summary: The source records the displayed value as the conjectured highest possible nonlinearity in even dimension.
